name: wp-vite-starter
description: WordPress starter theme with a wp-env + Vite local development harness, image optimization, cache-busted assets, and rsync-based CI deployment.

scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=local vite build && npm run press:images
scripts.build:stg: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging vite build && npm run press:images
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build && npm run press:images
scripts.db:import: gzip -dfk sql/wpenv.sql.gz && wp-env run cli wp db import sql/wpenv.sql && rm -f sql/wpenv.sql
scripts.db:export: wp-env run cli wp db export sql/wpenv.sql; gzip -f sql/wpenv.sql
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:style && npm run lint:es
scripts.build:prod: vite build && npm run generate-version && npm run press:images && npm run copy-theme

$comment:dom-serializer: Not imported by our code. vite-plugin-svg-sprite-component require()s dom-serializer without declaring it (its own deps are only htmlparser2 and magic-string), so it resolves only when npm happens to hoist it to the top level. Declaring it here makes that explicit rather than depending on node_modules layout — without it, `npm ci` can nest it and the build dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The plugin was last published in 2022 and was written against dom-serializer 1.x; 3.x is kept here because it was verified to produce byte-identical sprite output. Re-check that if it is bumped again, and remove this only if the plugin is replaced.
$comment:overrides: Transitive-only pins for advisories whose direct dependency has not yet released a bump. Each is a patched release the parent still works with, verified by exercising that parent (wp-env start and a wp-cli call for the simple-git pins, lint for postcss-selector-parser). postcss-selector-parser is pinned because npm's own 'fix' for it is to DOWNGRADE markuplint to 4.11.5, a regression rather than a fix. Re-check these on each dependency sweep and drop any the parent has caught up with.
author: John Evans
$comment:engines: The floor is dictated by dependencies, not preference: vite and rolldown declare ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0, so the previous >=20.11.0 was never actually installable. engine-strict=true in .npmrc enforces this at install time. lint-staged is held at ^16 for the same reason — 17.x requires Node >=22.22.1, which would raise this floor past several current LTS installs. If you move the project to Node 22+, lint-staged 17 becomes available and this pin can go.
